questions.q: This course is very practical: you build three real apps, so you get lots of ___ experience.
questions.explainRo: **Hands-on experience** = experiență practică, exact ce câștigi construind aplicații reale.

questions.q: After ten years as a nurse, Ioana decided to ___ and is now training to be a web designer.
questions.explainRo: **Switch careers** = a schimba cariera, adică a trece la o meserie complet nouă.

questions.q: Meeting my business partner at a hackathon was the ___ (turn) point of my career.
questions.explainRo: **Turning point** = punct de cotitură, momentul care schimbă totul.

questions.q: Before I moved to Cluj, I ___ in a tiny flat with three other students.
questions.explainRo: „Live” aici descrie o stare din trecut, deci folosim **used to**, nu „would”.

questions.q: I ___ wake up at six, but now that I work from home, I sleep until eight.
questions.explainRo: Un obicei din trecut care nu mai e valabil = **used to + verb** (după „be/get used to” ar trebui „waking”).

questions.audio: Did you use to play in a band?
answers: Did you use to play in a band?
questions.explainRo: În întrebări cu **did** scriem **use to**, fără „d”, pentru că „did” ia deja timpul trecut.

questions.q: My parents aren't used to ___ (pay) by phone, so they always carry cash.
questions.explainRo: După **be used to** vine verbul cu **-ing**, pentru că „to” este aici prepoziție.

questions.q: We ran all the way through the airport, but when we got to the gate, our plane ___.
questions.explainRo: Avionul decolase **înainte** să ajungem noi, deci folosim **past perfect**: had already taken off.

questions.q: I ___ (have) a shower when my client called, so I missed the call.
questions.explainRo: Acțiunea în desfășurare, întreruptă de apelul clientului, se pune la **past continuous**: was having.

questions.ro: Își căuta un loc de muncă de șase luni.
questions.explainRo: **Past perfect continuous** (had been + -ing) subliniază durata unei acțiuni până la un moment din trecut.

questions.ro: Te-ai obișnuit deja cu noul laptop?
questions.explainRo: **Get used to** + substantiv = a te obișnui treptat cu ceva; la present perfect: have you got used to…?

questions.ro: Nu sunt obișnuit să lucrez cu clienți din alte fusuri orare.
answers: I'm not used to working with clients in other time zones.
I am not used to working with clients in other time zones.
I'm not used to working with clients from other time zones.
I am not used to working with clients from other time zones.
I'm not used to working with clients in different time zones.
I am not used to working with clients in different time zones.
I'm not used to working with clients from different time zones.
I am not used to working with clients from different time zones.
questions.explainRo: „A fi obișnuit să…” = **be used to + -ing**, deci „I'm not used to working”, nu „used to work”.
